# s327 — slicer land checks a merged branch and marks its slice done

`slicer land ID --branch BRANCH --note TEXT` checks that the branch is merged into HEAD and that the slice's relay runs have ended, then runs `done --render --check`, and prints the git commands left for the person landing (commit, worktree remove, branch delete). slicer itself still commits nothing.

**Findings:** outer-session wishlist 2026-10-16, item 6: landing is about seven hand-run steps per slice · **Size:** M · **Tree:** slicer

**2026-10-17** — Ready for review: slicer land ID --branch BRANCH --note TEXT refuses unknown branch (usage), unmerged tip (not_merged) and an active relay run (run_active) before writing, then runs done --render --check and prints the git commands left (commit, worktree remove, branch -d). **Not in this slice:** running the suite; merging; running the printed git commands; slivers (`done` with several ids keeps that path).

## Why

Each landing on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 was the same hand-run sequence:
- merge;
- suite;
- `done ID --note … --render --check`;
- `git add -A .slicer`, then commit;
- save the relay ledger (unneeded since s298);
- `git worktree remove`, then `git branch -d`.

Two of those checks are easy to get wrong by hand: whether the branch really is merged into HEAD, and whether a relay run for the slice is still active. slicer can make both checks with git calls already on its allowlist, and it can print the rest. The git allowlist stays closed: slicer does not commit, push or tag.

## Files

- `src/slicer/ops.py` or a new `src/slicer/land.py`:
  - resolve BRANCH with `vcs.resolve`, and refuse with `not_merged` unless its tip is an ancestor of HEAD (`vcs.is_ancestor`);
  - refuse with `run_active` when `relayrun.list_runs` has an active run on ID, naming the run;
  - then the existing `done` path, with `--render` and `--check`;
  - find the sibling worktree checked out on BRANCH (`vcs.sibling_worktrees`), if any, for the printed commands.
- `src/slicer/cli.py`, `land`: `--branch` (required), `--note` (required, as for `done`) and `--json`. The text output ends with the commands to run, one per line:
  - `git add -A .slicer && git commit -m "ID done"`;
  - `git worktree remove PATH`, when a worktree is found;
  - `git branch -d BRANCH`.
- `docs/landing.md` (use `land` in place of the `done` line), `docs/commands.md`, `docs/agents.md` (the codes `not_merged` and `run_active`, and the payload), `CHANGELOG.md` under Added.
- `tests/test_land.py`.
